title: Drag the Queen In
setup: Black's king is sealed behind g7 and h7, and its queen on b6 is the only piece watching d8.
hint: The black king cannot move at all. Use that to decide where its queen will have to go.
explanation:
## The Idea

The king on h8 has no square, so {{Rd8+}} can only be met by {{Qxd8}} — which drags the queen onto d8, where a knight check from f7 will reach it. {{Nf7+}} forks it and the king, {{Kg8}} is forced, and {{Nxd8}} wins the queen for a rook.
